title: bunny-perf-evidence/1 round line
description: One case on one side in one round of a cargo xtask perf --evidence file. Properties are listed in the order the writer emits them.

schema.description: The format identifier and version, carried by every line.

kind.description: The line kind: this is a round line.

case.description: The harness case, such as num/sqrt.

side.description: base for the base revision (the report's Before), candidate for the working tree (After).

round.description: The round, from 1. Odd rounds ran the base first, even rounds the candidate first.

p50.description: Median nanoseconds per call in this round, as the harness printed it.

p95.description: 95th percentile nanoseconds per call in this round, as the harness printed it.

p99.description: 99th percentile nanoseconds per call in this round, as the harness printed it.
